intent: Give the new Epopeja character-sheet app (~/epopeja_karta) a launcher icon from the shared family, and let it run on the phone under focus mode.
scope: Non-goal: the app itself lives in its own repo (~/epopeja_karta) and is not part of this change
Non-goal: no accent change - the family accent #B8862E is shared, apps differ by glyph only
changes: Added the quill-nib glyph: a filled dip-pen nib with a true vent hole and slit (fill-rule=evenodd), sized so every gap clears MIN_NEGATIVE_SPACE (36px) and the ink stays inside SAFE_BOX.
First draft was a symmetric almond and rendered as a map pin; the shipped shape has a flat shoulder, which is what makes it read as a nib.
Registered epopeja_karta -> quill-nib with the shared #B8862E accent, linux=False (a linux/ target exists for desktop development only, so no hicolor set or desktop entry).
Whitelisted com.kuhy.epopeja_karta in the focus-mode config; not yet deployed to the device, so config and phone are intentionally out of sync until deploy.sh runs.

verification.evidence: 44 passed. Registry tests cover the new entry: every app references a real glyph, accents are shared, no glyph paints the background colour.
254 stmts, 32 branches, 0 missed - 100% on apps.py and glyphs.py included.
(0, 0) - no overflow on either axis, same as the receipt-split reference.
Wrote 6 asset files and regenerated the Android mipmaps; mipmap-xxxhdpi/ic_launcher.png visually confirmed as the nib, not the stock Flutter beach icon.

ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit, shellcheck, codespell, binary-file block and secret scan all pass. Two hooks fail for reasons outside this change: 'workflow contract for multi-file code changes' needs a contract artifact, and 'pytest with coverage enforcement' aborts on pre-existing collection errors in code_tutor and wsg_grabber. Both must be resolved before this is committed - they are not bypassed.

risks: The focus-mode whitelist entry has no effect until deploy.sh is run against the phone; until then a com.kuhy.epopeja_karta install would be killed within ~1s at home.
quill-nib is a filled silhouette, so it depends on fill-rule=evenodd keeping the vent and slit as true holes; a renderer change that ignores that would paint them charcoal and break icon_monochrome.
rollback: Remove the epopeja_karta entry from APPS, the quill-nib entry from GLYPHS and its _QUILL_NIB body, and the whitelist line from phone_focus_mode/config.sh.
Re-run the app_icons test suite and confirm 100% coverage still holds; re-run deploy.sh if the whitelist had already been pushed to the device.
